proposed_capability: Track quality, progress, water and fertilizer independently for each observed active-household plant and plan guarded on-lot sourcing or affordable purchase with independent personal inventory readback.
player_save_control_impact: Pure current-observation proposals, preserving human, needs, queue and save authority. No native input, save or Windows settings changes.
expected_outcome: Bounded per-target quality and care, source on-lot supplies first, buy only the checked affordable shortfall, and require selected-Sim inventory readback before fertilizer use.
negative_tests: Good fertilizer never infers or requests a refill because quality is Nice.
Incomplete lot survey, player-reserved supplies, unsafe funds, or unverified affordance do not justify a purchase.
A purchase proposal never grants inventory credit or repeats while acquisition outcome is unknown.
rollback_path: Revert the gardening quality policy PR. No runtime mutation or save migration.
unresolved_unknowns: Exact-build EA affordances, purchase settlement, native activation and outcome proof belong to issue #171.
decision_rationale: Extend the current strict inventory-first spine; preserve source-only proposals and existing non-enrolled callers.
